flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ then Find the store's membership or subscription and join it.
Get the text that confirms you are a member and save as {{join_confirmation}}.
If there is no membership or subscription, @v16:"store "none" as join_confirmation."

Then cancel the membership from the account area.
If a form is required, @v16:"fill it with simple test text."
Keep going until the site confirms the membership is cancelled, and store that confirmation text as cancel_confirmation.
If any button guilt-trips you for leaving (for example "No, I hate saving money"), @v16:"Get its exact text and save as {{guilt_text}}." otherwise @v16:"store "none" as guilt_text."
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.
